title: Mutual insurer.
bodyText: A mutual insurer means an incorporated insurer without capital stock, the governing body of which is elected by its policyholders. The policyholders, who are the insurer's owners, are known as members.
bodyHtml: §431:3-106  Mutual insurer.  A mutual insurer means an incorporated insurer without capital stock, the governing body of which is elected by its policyholders.  The policyholders, who are the insurer's owners, are known as members. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
